subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should ClawSweeper production publish `/bay-demo` as an unauthenticated public-by-URL experiment with bounded live terminal and timing presentation state?
rationale: Technical correctness, strong proof, contributor ownership, and automerge opt-in cannot determine whether the repository should operate and maintain this additional discoverable production surface.

options.title: Accept the experiment
options.body: Explicitly own the public audience, bounded state semantics, assets, runtime cost, and ongoing maintenance surface, then allow exact-head automerge gating.

options.title: Require access control
options.body: Keep the implementation but add Cloudflare Access or application authentication before exposing the route.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Do not deploy the additional production surface without maintainer sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Accept the experiment
recommendation.body: Explicitly own the public audience, bounded state semantics, assets, runtime cost, and ongoing maintenance surface, then allow exact-head automerge gating.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner for the production publication boundary based on dashboard/release context and the PR timeline.
